g.text: Study case or topic and scenario

g.class: n fHF07 fHF08 fHF09 fHF10 fAF04

svg.desc: [["HF-01", "Happy", "Start and learn", "Welcome screen → Main page → Navigation → Explore → Chapter. Welcome closes, main page shows counters and version; a chapter opens; answers are saved and the progress ring updates. Tests: TC-02, TC-05, TC-07, TC-11."], ["HF-02", "Happy", "Find a topic", "Navigation → Search → Chapter → Glossary. Search finds content across chapters and opens it; glossary terms open from the menu and from term pop-ups. Tests: TC-05, TC-20."], ["HF-03", "Happy", "Explore maps and timeline", "Explore → QMS map → Regulatory Timeline → FDA Premarket & Postmarket. QMS map rows and pop-ups, timeline milestones with official links, FDA pathways. Tests: TC-06, TC-12."], ["HF-04", "Happy", "Training mode", "Navigation → Training mode → Training result. Random questions, feedback after each answer, score and rings. Tests: TC-02, TC-07."], ["HF-05", "Happy", "Selected dilemmas", "Navigation → Selected Dilemmas. Three options with analysis; one recommended path. Tests: TC-02, TC-04."], ["HF-06", "Happy", "Inspection", "Navigation → Inspection: choose → Opening meeting → Inspection questions → Closing meeting. Choose a case or topic; opening meeting; 12 or 20 questions with auto-advance; closing meeting with score, observations and summary; optional read aloud. Tests: TC-17, TC-18, TC-24, TC-25."], ["HF-07", "Happy", "Fill a QA form", "Navigation → Daily QA Work → Form or template → Export. Choose a QMS area and form; load the sample or start a new record; edit; export Word and PDF. Tests: TC-21, TC-22, TC-23, TC-26."], ["HF-08", "Happy", "Change impact assessment", "Navigation → Daily QA Work → Change Impact Assessment → Export. Description, impact questions, regulatory assessment, classification, review and export. Tests: TC-10, TC-20."], ["HF-09", "Happy", "Statistics", "Navigation → Statistics → Export. Sampling plan, MSA or Gage R&R with results and Excel/PDF export. Tests: TC-08."], ["HF-10", "Happy", "Risk management", "Navigation → Risk management → Risk Management Tools → Risk drafts → Export. Device type, topic content, worksheet with IDs and traceability, drafts, export. Tests: TC-09, TC-24."], ["HF-11", "Happy", "Quick Survey", "Main page → Quick Survey. Answer, submit, send the answers by share, e-mail or copy. Tests: TC-19."], ["HF-12", "Happy", "Records and issues", "Main page → Hidden menu → V&V records → Issue log → Screen flow map. Download V&V records; log and follow up issues; view this map. Tests: TC-15, TC-27."], ["AF-01", "Alternative", "Leave inspection or choose another case", "Inspection questions → Inspection: choose. Leave link and 'choose another' return to the picker; results stay hidden until the closing meeting. Tests: TC-17."], ["AF-02", "Alternative", "Slow answer", "Inspection questions. After 30 s the investigator looks concerned, a wristwatch bubble shows and the timer turns red. Tests: TC-17, TC-24."], ["AF-03", "Alternative", "Empty survey", "Quick Survey. Submit without answers is refused with a message. Tests: TC-19."], ["AF-04", "Alternative", "Blank record", "Form or template → Export. New record starts empty; empty fields print as lines to fill by hand. Tests: TC-21, TC-26."], ["AF-05", "Alternative", "Phone layout", "Navigation → Daily QA Work → Risk management. Bottom bar navigation; area and topic pickers open a bottom sheet. Tests: TC-05, TC-24."], ["AF-06", "Alternative", "Offline and update", "Welcome screen → Main page. Installed app opens from cache offline and picks up a new version on the next visit. Tests: TC-16."], ["AF-07", "Alternative", "Reset progress", "Training result. Progress and rings reset on request. Tests: TC-07."]]
